state: frozen before the first scored invocation of the four-component runner

scope.evidence: authored synthetic development workload; no independent holdout or real-user study
scope.consumer: fixed config-policy selection and handwritten algorithm checks; not generated-code accuracy
scope.packing: same original full source blocks, native order, skip blocks that do not fit; no truncation or refill
scope.budget: exactly a 2400 Unicode-character ceiling including source headers; not a model-token budget
scope.book: v0.4.0 lexical recall, native hierarchy/FTS metadata, limit 5, native budget 100000 for candidate IDs; result cache disabled
scope.claude-mem-fts: pinned SessionSearch.searchObservations, native SQLite schema/FTS triggers; supplied title/text/date; no observer, Chroma, worker, timeline or generated semantic fields
scope.ai-memory-hybrid: pinned official executable, native MCP memory_query, local all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384 dimensions, native 512-token model input limit), original title/body, episodic tier, empty tags, unpinned; native write-time metadata, not original source timestamps
scope.billion-context: pinned upstream searchBlocks after syntax-only TypeScript erasure; uniform assistant message role, supplied title/body/project; no host decompression or original timestamp field
scope.representation: same source content and project scope do not imply identical indexed fields, timestamp semantics, native result surfaces, or storage work
scope.query_timing: outer adapter-call wall time only; Book in-process recall, Claude/Billion persistent JSON process bridge, ai-memory loopback MCP HTTP; native inner timings remain separately named
scope.read_timing: ai-memory full-page reads validate every unique recalled supplied page after all checkpoint searches; excluded from search timing and not an end-to-end retrieval-plus-read measurement
scope.setup: canonical Book incremental ingestion/export is separate; each query engine opens once per checkpoint; external engines freshly index all visible supplied pages; setup is not a comparable product lifecycle
scope.repetitions: at least three timing repetitions per query with rotating backend order; repeated scores retained, not additional independent quality cases; native internal caches warm naturally
scope.missing_answer: all missing-evidence queries retained; nonempty context is a retrieval diagnostic, not a hallucination or generated-answer claim
scope.upstream_versions: explicit immutable pins, not a claim to run the latest releases

primary: fixed known-policy consumer passes / 48 eligible cases
secondary: all paired wins, losses, ties and mixed outcomes
analysis.stress: Reuse the same 80 query identities at all three predeclared maintenance-noise levels; this is 80 authored questions across three conditions, not 240 independent questions or a holdout.
analysis.repetitions: Three native calls per query/backend; quality uses first predeclared call. Preserve every native result and all per-repeat scores. Report changed hit order/context/scores without choosing the best repeat.
analysis.timing: Separate first query searches from repeated searches, inner native times, adapter wall time, common packing, delayed native reads and setup. No whole-product speed ratio or end-to-end LLM latency claim.
analysis.fairness: Identical complete original bodies, titles, explicit project scope and five native slots; common unmodified whole-block packer. Native metadata, ingest paths and query surfaces differ as documented.
analysis.interpretation: A complete evidence win supports a supplied-source retrieval claim on this fixture. It does not establish global superiority, generated-code accuracy, real engineering productivity or superiority to every competitor mode.
analysis.reporting: Retain all conditions, backend outcomes, raw responses, source bundles, setup records, failed attempts and errors. README may focus only on the predeclared 2400-character profile but must retain material losses and link the full evidence.

invariants: no changes to Book runtime, frozen workload/evaluator, external adapters, locks or bridges
no future checkpoint sources or gold labels passed to retrieval
no supplementing native top-five results using evidence labels
verify runtime/evaluator/upstream execution hashes before and after
all source, budget and native full-read checks must be reported
failure_policy: Stop a condition on an adapter/provenance failure and retain all partial outputs. Correct harness infrastructure only with an explicit amendment and preserved prior source/attempt; never tune product retrieval using these scored runs.
native_default_bridge: Existing v0.4.0 omitted-default versus explicit 2400/5 validation covers the base 80-case fixture. The shared packer is a component boundary; no untested equivalence is claimed for the larger noise conditions.
